title: Accessibility color contrast check

requirements.text: Relative luminance and contrast ratio are computed per WCAG 2.x
Pass/fail is reported for AA and AAA, normal and large text, and the 3:1 non-text threshold
Semi-transparent foreground colors are composited over the background before measuring
Invalid color strings are refused rather than measured as black
Colors in rgb(), hsl(), oklch() and named forms are accepted, not just hex
Every foreground/background token pair in each theme is checked automatically, failing the build on regressions

evidence.name: wcag-contrast: ratio vectors and AA/AAA thresholds
wcag-contrast: ratio vectors and AA/AAA thresholds

notes: capability:color converts between hex, HSL and OKLCH values but does not parse CSS color functions; no tool audits theme token pairs.
